<b>Snitchflies</b> are [[Enemies (Silksong)|enemies]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. Members of the [[Snitchbugs|Snitchbug]] species, they are looters almost always found in pairs all over [[Pharloom]],<ref>Snitchfly [[Hunter's Journal (Silksong)|Hunter's Journal]] entry: <i>"Pernicious looter found all over Pharloom."</i></ref> who prioritise stealing [[Rosaries]] from [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]] over fighting her.

== Behaviour and Tactics ==
Snitchflies often come in pairs and may call in allies from the foreground to try and pincer Hornet between them.<br>
Snitchflies are rummaging through things whilst idle, not wandering at all. If Hornet gets at a certain distance, they stop to look back at her, tensing up. If she moves any closer, all Snitchflies in the area begin their assault.<br>
Snitchflies perform high, evasive jumps back and forth between attacks, and have three moves:
* <b>Leaping Rummage:</b> Leaps at Hornet. If it makes contact during the leap, it briefly latches onto her, scratching {{R|20-30}} and dealing {{Damage|1+1}}.
* <b>Gather:</b> Runs along the ground and collects any loose Rosaries. This move is always used if there are any loose Rosaries in its vicinity, taking priority over all other moves. If the Snitchfly is defeated, it drops all Rosaries it has stolen in addition to its base drops.
* <b>Flee:</b> Tenses up for a moment and then flies offscreen and leaves the room if the Snitchfly has gathered at least {{R|25-30}} and there are no Rosaries nearby. Keeps its contact damage hitbox throughout the whole animation. Also used if fleeing from the ones in the [[Choral Chambers]] and when approaching the one inside the ruins of [[Pilgrim's Rest]] in [[Act 3]].

If Hornet has the [[Thief's Mark]] equipped, Snitchflies stay passive until attacked. The [[Magnetite Brooch]] works on Rosaries dropped from Snitchfly attacks, helping to quickly retrieve many before they can be stolen.

== Location ==
Two Snitchflies can be found in [[Bilewater]], scavenging corpses near a [[Flea]]. After the Flea is rescued, one Snitchfly continues to respawn in this room.<br>
Two Snitchflies can be found in the lower part of [[the Slab]] after obtaining [[Key of Apostate]].<br>
Another two can be found in the room directly to the west of [[Grand Bellway]], in the Choral Chambers. Only appear after defeating the [[Cogwork Dancers]] or obtaining the [[Clawline]], replacing a [[Choristor]] that could previously be found in the room.<br>
During [[Act 3]], they can be found scavenging the wrecked ruins of [[Bone Bottom]] and [[Pilgrim's Rest]].
